label: Repost
intent: The post is reshared: the two repost arrows fire round their loop. Light: both arrows pull back along their legs and fire forward, the left arrow up and the right arrow down a beat behind, each head landing on its mark with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: a deeper pull-back, a harder fire and two rebounds.

shaft-a.//: starts at the bottom middle, so draw trims the end under the head

motion.//: The head rides the shaft's end: shaft length is 23.43, so head offset = 23.43 * (1 - draw), with the same keys and eases.
